text:
emma: Quick pitch  Launchpad Labs: a compact 2-session webinar for infra/platform engineers. Session 1 = Practical Cost Hacks (quant + batching + caching). Session 2 = Live Resilience Workshop (routing, canaries, fallbacks). 50 mins + 10 Q&A. Aim for two Tuesdays in June. Thoughts?

raj: +1. Prefer hands-on demos vs slides. For the resilience workshop I'll demo policy-driven routing and an intentional failover. Need a short prep doc for commands and where logs stream.

sophia: I'll own the cost narrative. Plan: 5 slides with real numbers (per-token cost, effective throughput with batching, Dedicated vs hosted delta). Will include a tiny table with q8 vs fp16 perf. ETA Wed.

mina: Can we ship a tiny post-webinar lab (CLI + docker-compose) so attendees can reproduce the bench? I'll assemble a repo with copy-paste commands and a pared-down dataset. Keep it 10-15 cmds max.

oliver: Ops checklist: reserve a small Dedicated pool for each rehearsal (2 hrs), enable anonymized traffic replay, confirm recording and captions, and pre-provision test tokens. I'll create a runbook with exact failover steps & "host cue" text.

isha: Lead routing spec: propose tagging leads by session + interest. Suggested tags: `launchpad.session=cost|resilience`, `interest=quant|routing|ops`, `demo_request=true|false`. Nurture flow: session-specific followup + cost playbook for cost attendees, resilience checklist for routing attendees.

emma: Example tag snippet for CRM/dev:
```
metadata:
  event_name: launchpad_labs
  session_tag: launchpad.session
  interests: [quant, routing, caching]
  lead_props: [utm_source, campaign, demo_request]
```
Rehearsal schedule: full dress 1 week prior, quick run 1 day prior (30m), host tech check 20m before show. Host script will include exact fallback phrasing to call out. Everyone confirm speaker commitment by EOD Tue.

raj: I'll pair with @oliver on the runbook. Example demo snippet I want included:
```
# simulate burst profile
redwood-cli generate --model redwood-medium-q8 --profile burst --tokens 512 --rate-limit 200
# flip routing policy to fallback
redwood-cli routing set --policy fallback-to-redwood-small --threshold-ms 120
```
Make sure logs stream is included in the runbook.

sophia: I'll attach the benchmark csv and the 3 eval prompts to the marketing drive. Also will prepare one slide showing cost delta when enabling KV cache.

mina: Lab README will include a "quick check" after each step and a one-liner to reset routing. I'll aim to ship repo by Thu.

oliver: Runbook will have a short "failover cue" to read out during demo: "Switching to fallback for latency preservation — continuing the demo." I'll add infra contacts and rollback commands.

deploy-bot: calendar: created placeholders for Launchpad Labs Session 1 & 2. Reminders: hosts 48h & 20m.

emma: Great. Action items: emma = landing page + promo copy Tue, sophia = bench slides Wed, mina = lab repo Thu, raj+oliver = demo runbook Mon, isha = nurture + tag spec Tue. I'll send invites and a short host script now. :seedling:
